Current independent Shiny inventory lists this exact spooky size image as available when encountered; original cached body matches latest monitor observation.

records.qualification: Exact costume plus size independently named by GO sprite source; normal/Shiny originals decoded and paired contact sheet visually reviewed. No generic Spooky key is assigned a size, and ordinary uncostumed sizes remain separate.
